description: This file comprises unit tests for the module 'transcript-tools', testing functions extractToolCallNames, hasToolCall, and countToolResults, primarily focused on verifying tool call extraction and counting logic.

methods.name: extractToolCallNames
methods.description: Extracts tool call names from an object containing toolName or content blocks, normalizing and de-duplicating names.

methods.name: hasToolCall
methods.description: Determines if an object contains any tool call references based on content or toolName.

methods.name: countToolResults
methods.description: Counts total tool result blocks and error blocks within the content, tracking the number of errors.
